description.en: dsh-sd-bridge-guard插件已发布，可以帮你完善提示词，提高图片质量，并做到dsh无限制生图
Provides a visual workbench interface for organizing and managing development tasks.
description.zh: 提供可视化工作台界面，用于组织和管理开发任务。

description.en: 歸藏设计 · DeepSeek Harness 插件：网页 PPT、图文卡片、网页排版、去 AI 味四个 skill，一套设计系统；作品库、内容生产工作流、语气档案
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Local-first voice conversations for DSH. Run speech recognition and speech synthesis on your own machine, with optional external providers.
description.zh: 在本地跑语音识别和语音合成，让 DSH 支持实时语音对话，也可接入外部服务。

description.en: 为本地监听器预留足够的请求头预算，并在启动后退休旧启动 cookie，避免桌面欢迎握手被 431 永久锁死。
大肥鱼饲养手册
DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3 破甲/清理插件（dsh-purge 分支）：82 条补丁、逐字节可回滚备份、灵魂闸门、31 条单元测试 | DSH jailbreak + patch/uninstall toolkit for 0.2.1-rc.3
DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin: permanently delete sessions (including opened ones) and show/hide archived sessions per workspace.
DSH 会话接力插件 · 长会话到点先问你一句，把需求/进度/下一步写成交接文档，开个干净新会话接着干（手动 /handoff 或自动触发）。 Session handoff for DeepSeek Harness.
Archive the original context before DSH compaction replaces it with a summary — wraps the official summarize(), no engine changes.
YesPlayMusic controls and now-playing status for dsh-TUI
Two-phase long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-session extraction + global consolidation, always-injected summary, and memory_list/read/search/add tools.
NovelAI Diffusion V4.5 Full image generation for DeepSeek Harness (nai_generate_image tool)
DeepSeek Harness 插件：让 agent 默认用中文思考与回复（移植自 superpowers-zh）
Permanently delete DSH sessions from the file system, right from the sidebar conversation menu — 在 DSH 侧边栏菜单真正物理删除会话，而非归档隐藏。
三重一大决策台账核对（按前置研究、会议审议与决议记录核对程序留痕，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查国企「三重一大」决策台账的程序留痕，看议题是否记录提案依据、前置研究等环节是否齐全。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness LLM adapter bridge for Qoder CN, Qoder International, Tencent CodeBuddy and MiniMax Code subscriptions. It reuses each provider's own SDK or official ACP server and CLI login, shows available quota, and exposes per-provider settings pages

DeepSeek Harness LLM adapter for Qoder CN and Qoder International subscriptions, built on the official Qoder Agent SDKs. Reuses the local qoderclicn / qodercli login, shows the account quota the Qoder clients display, and exposes a fully configurable sett
DSH 的轻量 QQ 机器人插件（零运行时依赖）：WebSocket 收群聊/私聊消息接入 dsh 会话，并提供 qq_message / qq_group / qq_bot 三个工具供 AI 主动调用（发消息、发文件、读消息、按需下载附件、群管理、查状态）。自带「设置 → QQ 机器人」页面，支持手机 QQ 扫码绑定，无需手抄凭据。
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for stock analysis, screening, and strategy backtesting across A/HK/US/JP/KR/TW markets
维修工单结算核对（按项目金额、配件工时合计与结算总额核对算术自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 自动核对机动车维修工单的金额和填写完整性，算错、漏填一眼就能发现。

description.en: Generic idea manager for the DSH Web GUI: Host-authoritative /api/ideas ledger, capture, 4-column kanban (open / under review / archived / declined), one-click execution launch (mirrored TaskBoard card or a direct session), optional TaskBoard mirror; moun
description.zh: 把灵感随手丢进看板，AI 帮你收集、评分和整理，想法不再散落各处。

description.en: Two PDF tools for the DSH sidebar in one install — jump to any page and browse the whole document with locally rendered pages and thumbnails, or open a PDF with DSH's native preview. Ships a /pdf command too.
description.zh: 一个包装两个 PDF 工具：按页码跳页、用本地渲染的页面和缩略图整本浏览，也可用 DSH 原生预览直接打开；另带一个 /pdf 命令。

description.en: A board for DeepSeek Harness that composes stations, workflows and projects from separate Git repositories; GitHub is the access gate.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 把独立 Git 仓库中的站点、工作流和项目组合成一块看板；以 GitHub 作为访问关口。

description.en: Adds four tools to a Session. create_session opens a new Session in a named workspace or in any existing folder and delivers one prompt into it; session_message sends one more message into a Session that is already running or finished (queued, so it lands after the current turn); read_session_transcript reads back what a Session said and whether its current turn has finished; list_dispatched_sessions lists what this plugin dispatched and each one's state right now. Host-half plugin, no UI — it calls the host's own session primitives rather than reimplementing them. Restart DSH after installing.
description.zh: 给会话加四个工具：create_session 在指定工作区或任意一个已存在的文件夹里开一个新会话，并把一段提示词投进去；session_message 给一个已经在跑或已结束的会话再追加一条消息（排队投递，落在当前这一轮之后）；read_session_transcript 按会话 id 读回它说过什么、当前这一轮结束没有；list_dispatched_sessions 列出本插件派送过哪些会话、各自此刻什么状态。宿主半边插件，没有界面，调用的是宿主自己的建会话能力。装完需重启 DSH。

description.en: QQ Zone poster for DeepSeek Harness: scan a QQ login once, then let the model publish posts with mood-matched sticker images, with a daily cap and a silent headless Chrome session.
description.zh: QQ 空间发说说插件：手机 QQ 扫一次码登录，之后由模型按心情挑表情包发说说，支持每天条数上限，静默 Chrome 不占屏。

description.en: Xray-core supervisor and router for DSH with VLESS import, global/China-direct/whitelist routing, a three-card live panel, and self-update.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Xray 受管内核与分流：VLESS 导入、全局/国内直连/白名单路由、三卡片实时面板与自更新。

description.en: Defines multi-agent team rosters as YAML or JSON files, validates them, bridges each member into dsh-agent-teams member arguments, and verifies the result against the running team.
description.zh: 用 YAML/JSON 定义多智能体团队档案，校验后把成员桥接成 dsh-agent-teams 的建员参数，并对照运行中的团队核对结果。

description.en: Bundles 50 AMD ROSS agent skills for Vivado, Vitis HLS, Versal segmented configuration, Vitis AI, and hardware debug into DeepSeek Harness, with a left-sidebar catalog panel for filtering, searching, and copying skill invocations.
description.zh: 把 AMD ROSS 的 50 个 Vivado、Vitis HLS、Versal 分段配置、Vitis AI 与硬件调试技能装进 DeepSeek Harness，并在左侧栏提供可筛选、搜索、展开与复制的技能目录面板。

description.en: API contract studio for DeepSeek Harness: decide the seven things that must be locked before coding, author and review OpenAPI, classify breaking changes by how they actually break clients, and settle error shapes, versioning and deprecation — six playbooks plus a router.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 API 契约工作室：开工前先定七件事、写/审 OpenAPI、按「客户端具体坏在哪」分类破坏性变更，再定错误结构、版本与弃用——六本手册加一个路由。

description.en: Automatic session titles for DSH: names a session from its first prompt plus the first assistant reply ("project｜task") instead of truncating the prompt. Replaces the built-in session-title provider through a bundle patch, adds an "AI rename" entry to the session row menu with a preview dialog, and a settings page for the provider/model, the naming rules and a diagnostic event log. 49 unit tests.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话自动起名：首轮问答结束后用「项目｜具体任务」命名，而不是把提问截断。通过 bundle patch 顶替内置标题 provider，在会话行「…」菜单里加「AI 重命名」（先预览再应用），设置页可改 provider/model、命名规则并查看诊断日志。49 个单元测试。

description.en: Starts a BaseMind MCP server for each session's workspace and registers the code-intelligence tools it advertises, with no MCP row to configure. Requires BaseMind installed and on PATH (basemind serve); without it no tools are registered.
description.zh: 按会话工作区启动 BaseMind MCP server，并注册其对外提供的代码智能工具，无需配置 MCP 行。需先安装 BaseMind 并在 PATH 上（basemind serve）；否则不会注册任何工具。

description.en: Bing daily wallpaper as the app background: auto-refresh every day, pin any of the last 30 days.
description.zh: 必应每日壁纸作为界面背景：每天自动更换，可在最近 30 天中任选一天固定。

description.en: Registers Mol* file viewers with dsh-better-sidebar for PDB, mmCIF, MRC maps, small molecules and Chimera .cmm markers, including .gz, with a BioViewer workspace tab and bio_open / bio_add tools.
description.zh: 向 dsh-better-sidebar 注册 Mol* 文件预览器，支持 PDB、mmCIF、MRC 密度图、小分子和 Chimera .cmm 标记（含 .gz），并提供 BioViewer 工作区标签以及 bio_open / bio_add 工具。

description.en: A hard hat for AI coding: graded writes (L0 read-only / L1 workspace-only / L2 full) put privileged edits in a cage. Below the level it refuses to write and hands back a paste-ready block instead. Every path passes a raw-string traversal check plus realpath, so junction escapes are caught.
description.zh: 给 AI 编程戴上安全帽：L0 到 L2 分级拦截，把越权操作关进笼子——权限不够就不落盘，改给你一段可直接粘贴的替换稿；路径过两道闸，junction 逃逸也拦得住。

description.en: Breeze TTS client for DeepSeek Harness: connects to your own Breeze TTS server to read replies aloud and manage voice cloning (the server and its model must be deployed separately; hardware requirements are on the server side), with an optional cross-machine mode. Merges @dsh-external/dsh-plugin-local-ai-tts (abbccdd/dsh-localtts) and dsh-breeze-voices, carries code from 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts, and must not be installed alongside the two upstream plugins it merges.
description.zh: DSH 的 Breeze 语音客户端：连接你自己部署的 Breeze TTS 服务来朗读回复、管理音色克隆（服务与模型需单独部署，硬件门槛在服务端），另提供可选的跨机调用。本插件由 @dsh-external/dsh-plugin-local-ai-tts（abbccdd/dsh-localtts）与 dsh-breeze-voices 合并而来（含 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts 的代码），不能与这两个上游同装。

description.en: Hides opted-in third-party skills and MCP servers from the model-facing catalogs and serves them through one capability tool: search by intent, read the schema or the skill instructions, then call. A local journal records metadata only, never query text or arguments.
description.zh: 把选定代管的第三方技能与 MCP 服务器从原生工具目录收起，改由单个 capability 工具统一提供：按意图搜索、读 schema 或技能说明，再调用。本地日志只记录元数据，不记录查询文本与参数。

description.en: Injects SOUL, IDENTITY, AGENTS, and TOOLS into Claw session prompts. Hard dep (install together or single install fails): dsh-claw-permissions.
description.zh: 把 SOUL、IDENTITY、AGENTS、TOOLS 注入 Claw 会话提示词。硬依赖（需同装，否则单装会崩）：dsh-claw-permissions。

description.en: Shared diagnostic log used by the Claw agent governance plugins (dsh-claw suite).
description.zh: Claw Agent 治理插件共用的诊断日志（dsh-claw 套件）。

description.en: Watches the context budget of a DeepSeek Harness session: a colour dot in every turn footer (green <50%, yellow 50-65%, orange 65-80%, red >=80%) read from the official contextPressure projection, a reminder panel with a one-click new-session handoff at orange/red, the /context-watch and /handoff commands, and a static reasoning-rule prompt section. Budget and handoff read local session files only; the badge and reminder spend no tokens until the button is clicked.
description.zh: 看护 DeepSeek Harness 会话的上下文预算：每轮回复底部一个颜色点（绿<50%、黄50-65%、橙65-80%、红≥80%，读官方 contextPressure 投影），橙/红档在输入框下方出现提醒与「一键开新会话」交接按钮，另有 /context-watch 与 /handoff 命令和一个静态思考规则提示段。预算与交接只读本地会话文件，徽章和提醒不点按钮不花 token。

description.en: Shows the live DeepSeek account balance in the composer toolbar and prices each completed turn in CNY beside its token usage, using the official peak/off-peak table: peak on Beijing-time weekday mornings and afternoons, valley on weekends and statutory holidays. The balance needs a DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential; accounts signed in through DeepSeek OAuth show no chip.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在每轮完成对话的 token 用量旁显示按官方峰谷价计费的人民币金额：北京时间工作日上下午为高峰价，周末与法定节假日为空闲价。余额需要 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 凭据，仅通过 DeepSeek OAuth 登录的账号不显示余额。

description.en: Real session deletion for DSH: "Delete chat" in a session row moves its directory into ~/.dsh/session-trash, a Trash page in the sidebar lists, filters, restores and permanently deletes from there, and a CLI offers the same verbs without the GUI.
description.zh: 给 DSH 补上真正的会话删除：「⋯」里的 Delete chat 把会话目录移进 ~/.dsh/session-trash，侧栏回收站页面负责筛选、恢复与永久删除，另有 CLI 用同样的动词、不用开 GUI。

description.en: Replies to DingTalk direct messages as your own account — reads the bound DSH workspace, writes the answer, and sends it back through the dws CLI.
description.zh: 以你本人钉钉身份自动回复私聊：在绑定的 DSH 工作区里查资料生成回答，通过 dws CLI 以本人身份发出。

description.en: Paints a colored counter badge (green = unread completed sessions, orange = pending question or approval) on the DeepSeek Harness taskbar icon on Windows, and plays a chime when a session finishes. Fork of dthcle/dsh-badge-notify (MIT) with a completion chime and green/orange state colors; both draw the same taskbar badge, so the two cannot be enabled together.
description.zh: 在 Windows 任务栏的 DeepSeek Harness 图标上叠画彩色计数角标（绿=未读的已完成会话，橙=待回答提问或待批准权限），会话结束时播放提示音。基于 dthcle/dsh-badge-notify（MIT）二次开发，新增提示音与绿/橙状态色；两者都在同一个任务栏图标上叠画角标，不能同时启用。

description.en: Recovers a DeepSeek Harness turn that ended with reasoning only, with no text and no tool call, by steering the same turn one more step. Structure-only detection, so it costs no extra model call.
description.zh: 识别「整轮只有思考、既无正文也无工具调用」的空回合，让同一轮再走一步；纯结构判定，不额外调用模型。

description.en: Local-first experience library for DeepSeek Harness: indexed markdown knowledge with error-signature retrieval, failure capture, gap-to-entry closure, and a sidebar panel. Ships a sanitized starter library. No network access.
description.zh: 本地优先的经验库：给 DeepSeek Harness 的索引化 markdown 知识，支持错误签名检索、失败采集、缺口→条目闭环与侧边栏面板；自带脱敏起步库，不联网。

description.en: Windows desktop floating assistant for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top chat panel with streaming answers, model switching, and region-screenshot questions.
description.zh: Windows 桌面悬浮助手：常驻置顶的对话面板，框选屏幕区域直接提问，支持流式回答、模型切换与历史记录。

description.en: Two native tools for key-free Chinese/English search via 360, Bing RSS and DuckDuckGo, and static webpage text extraction, without a browser, Python or MCP subprocess.
description.zh: 两个原生工具，提供基于 360、Bing RSS 和 DuckDuckGo 的免 API Key 中英文搜索与静态网页正文读取，无需浏览器、Python 或 MCP 子进程。

description.en: Git workflow studio for DeepSeek Harness: pick a branch model, enforce Conventional Commits, review PRs by defect density, rewrite history safely, rescue lost commits with reflog, and version releases by actual behavior change.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作流工作室：定分支模型、统一提交规范、按缺陷密度评 PR、安全改写历史、用 reflog 救援丢失的提交，并按真实行为变化定版本号。

description.en: Connects a GitHub account to DSH from the composer button (OAuth device flow or a personal access token) and exposes one github_api tool for REST calls — create repositories, write files, read pull requests and workflow runs — with a read-only switch and an in-panel call log. A rewritten fork of Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect (MIT): device-flow Client IDs are no longer rejected, paths may carry query strings and non-ASCII characters, undici is no longer a hard dependency, and the panel has four tabs. Registers the same github_api tool name and the same credential namespace, so it cannot be installed alongside that plugin.
description.zh: 在对话框左下角连接你的 GitHub 账号（设备流或 Personal Access Token），提供一个 github_api 工具直接调 REST 接口——建仓库、写文件、读 PR 与 Actions，带只读开关和调用记录。改自 Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect（MIT）：不再拒收设备流 Client ID，路径可带查询串与非 ASCII 字符，不再硬依赖 undici，面板改成四页签。工具名 github_api 与凭据命名空间都与原插件相同，两者不能同时安装。

description.en: Gitee Enterprise work-item workbench in the Harness sidebar: browse projects and tasks, requirements, and bugs; inspect details, child tasks, comments, and Markdown; create or edit work items; and reference them with @.
description.zh: 在 Harness 侧栏提供 Gitee 企业版工作台：浏览项目及任务、需求、缺陷，查看详情、子任务、评论与 Markdown，支持新建或编辑工作项，并可通过 @ 引用。

description.en: Codebase knowledge graphs for DeepSeek Harness: seven graphify_* Agent tools, a /graphify command, and a Graphify page build and query a project graph locally with AST parsing (no API key), plus path/explain/god-node lookups and wiki/HTML/SVG/GraphML/Obsidian exports. Requires the graphify CLI (graphifyy); only full document/PDF/image extraction needs an LLM key.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码库知识图谱：7 个 graphify_* Agent 工具、/graphify 命令与 Graphify 页面，用本地 AST 解析构建并查询项目图谱（无需 API Key），支持路径 / 解释 / 枢纽节点查询与 wiki、HTML、SVG、GraphML、Obsidian 导出。需先安装 graphify CLI（graphifyy）；只有含文档 / PDF / 图片的完整抽取需要 LLM Key。

description.en: Turns an English paper PDF into a Chinese group-meeting .pptx whose figures and tables are the paper's own cropped pixels.
description.zh: 把英文论文 PDF 做成中文组会汇报 PPT，图表用原文真实像素。

description.en: Reads IDEA run configurations and launches Java, Spring Boot and Vue projects inside DeepSeek Harness, with colored logs and a fast java -cp startup path.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里读取 IDEA 运行配置，启动 Java / Spring Boot / Vue 项目并查看彩色日志，支持快速启动（java -cp 直启）。

description.en: Java efficient development plugin for DeepSeek Harness providing deterministic auto-fix for .java files, token-saving template intents, and cross-platform JDK/Gradle/Android SDK/FFmpeg/LWJGL/IDEA discovery with persistent caching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Java 高效开发插件，提供 .java 文件的决定性自动修复、节省 token 的模板意图、以及跨平台的 JDK/Gradle/Android SDK/FFmpeg/LWJGL/IDEA 自动发现与持久化缓存。

description.en: Governed literature library: import papers, extract text, keep one index row per entry, and verify quotes verbatim.
description.zh: 可治理的文献库：导入论文、抽取全文，每条文献只保留一行索引，并逐字核验摘录能在原文中查到。

description.en: Reviews destructive shell commands with a model before they run, asks you to confirm or blocks them, and aborts a running command once it has deleted too many files.
description.zh: 破坏性 shell 命令执行前由模型判断会不会造成不可逆破坏，判定会破坏时询问或拦下；命令运行中删除文件过多时中止。

description.en: Long-term notes and daily journals kept per workspace in a hot/cold archive, each tier with its own index and rebalanced once a day; read and written through seven memory_* tools, with a settings page for per-workspace options.
description.zh: 按工作空间保存日记与长期要点的冷热归档记忆：热档常驻、冷档下沉，每层各有一份索引，每天自动归纳一次；读写走七个 memory_* 工具，另有设置页可按工作空间调参数。

description.en: Adds per-model hide/show switches for custom (llm-pi-ai) providers to the DSH settings page. Hidden models disappear from the conversation model picker and are archived verbatim, so they can be restored at any time; disabling or uninstalling the plugin restores everything automatically. Built-in DeepSeek providers are not managed.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页给自定义（llm-pi-ai）提供商的每个模型加「隐藏 / 显示」开关。隐藏的模型会从对话底部的模型选择器消失，条目原样存档、随时可恢复；禁用或卸载本插件会自动全部还原。内置 DeepSeek 提供商不归本插件管。

description.en: Adds a `muse` subagent provider and the `subagent_muse` tool to DeepSeek Harness, so the main agent can hand one self-contained task to the Meta Muse Code CLI and get back only its final report. A patched fork of `@pascapone/dsh-muse-code` that loads on DSH 0.2.1: it carries local equivalents of the removed `settleRun` export and `subagents.start` method, and documents an optional proxy for the gateway stream-phase bug. Needs the `muse` CLI installed. Install either this fork or the upstream @pascapone/dsh-muse-code, not both: both register the same subagent-muse loader row.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 `muse` 子代理提供方与 `subagent_muse` 工具，主代理可把一整段任务外包给 Meta Muse Code CLI，只取回最终报告。这是 `@pascapone/dsh-muse-code` 的修补分叉，可在 DSH 0.2.1 上加载：内含被移除的 `settleRun` 导出与 `subagents.start` 方法的本地等价实现，并附网关流式 phase 缺陷的可选代理修正。需已安装 `muse` CLI。本分叉不能与上游 @pascapone/dsh-muse-code 同装：两者注册同一个 subagent-muse 加载行。

description.en: Adds a button left of the built-in Open In... in the session header that opens the current workspace directory in VS Code, fixing the desktop ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE environment leak that makes the built-in open-in-app fail with HTTP 502. Windows only: it locates Code.exe, so macOS and Linux are not supported yet.
description.zh: 在会话头部「打开方式」左侧新增按钮，一键在 VS Code 中打开当前工作区目录，修复桌面宿主 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 环境变量泄漏导致内置 open-in-app 启动 VS Code 失败（HTTP 502）的问题。仅支持 Windows：按 Code.exe 路径定位，macOS / Linux 尚未适配。

description.en: Lets the model turn an answer into a web page that lives right inside the chat. The show_page tool either fills one of 8 built-in templates (report, compare, checklist, dashboard, timeline, flashcards, quiz, flow), where the model writes only the content and the plugin does layout, interaction and saving, or saves a full page the model wrote itself (calculators, games, custom layouts). Hand-written pages get the same design as base styles inside a CSS @layer, so the page's own CSS still wins. The page appears under the reply at its content height, interactive and following DSH's light/dark theme. The page's localStorage is stored in DSH per page, so what users tick or type survives reopening and new versions, and the same page open in the chat and the right sidebar stays in sync. Each edit is saved as a new version you can flip back to. After saving, the page is checked in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (script errors, horizontal overflow, dark mode not applied) and problems go back to the model. The right sidebar shows the page full-size with versions, a gallery of all pages and export to PNG, PDF or HTML. Pages run in a sandboxed, separate-origin frame with a strict CSP: no access to DSH data and no fetch, XHR or WebSocket. Works on phones with dsh-mobile.
description.zh: 让模型把回答做成一页网页，直接放在对话里。show_page 工具可以套 8 种内置模板（报告、对比、清单、数据看板、时间线、学习卡片、测验、流程图），模型只写内容，排版、交互和保存由插件做；也可以存模型自己写的整页（计算器、小游戏、特别的版式）。自己写的页面也套上同一套设计，放在 CSS @layer 里，页面自己的样式照样盖得过它。页面按内容高度嵌在回复下面，能点能用，深浅色跟着 DSH 走。页面里的 localStorage 按页面存在 DSH 里，勾过、填过的东西重开、改出新版本都还在；同一页同时开在对话里和右侧栏，两边实时同步。改一次存一版，旧版能翻。存好后在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里体检（脚本报错、横向溢出、深色没跟上），问题交回模型改。右侧栏看整页、翻版本、看所有做过的页面，导出 PNG / PDF / HTML。页面跑在不同源的沙箱框里，CSP 很严：读不到 DSH 的数据，也不能联网取数据。配合 dsh-mobile 手机上也能用。

description.en: Pavement design methods as a judgement manual: 76 cards over 9 chapters on method selection, indicator assignment, parameter calibers, axle-load conversion and climate zoning, with the airport chapter recovered by re-OCR of the intact PDF.
description.zh: 路面设计方法判据手册：9 章 76 张卡，覆盖方法选型、指标指派、参数口径、轴载换算与气候分区；第九章机场道面曾整章丢失，已由原 PDF 重扫恢复。

description.en: Asphalt pavement skid resistance: 76 cards over 12 chapters on friction calibers, water film and hydroplaning, texture parameters, tire-road contact and maintenance decisions, each capability carrying its own when-not-to-use bound.
description.zh: 沥青路面抗滑：12 章 76 张卡，覆盖摩擦口径、水膜与滑水、纹理参数、胎路接触与养护决策，每条能力都带「什么时候别用」。

description.en: Pavement structural dynamics as a judgement manual: 59 cards over 8 chapters flagging which chapter name oversells its contents, which formulas break when copied, and which numbers cannot be cross-quoted.
description.zh: 路面结构动力学判据手册：8 章 59 张卡，指明哪章名不副实、哪些式子抄走就错、哪些数不能互引。

description.en: Federates a local DeepSeek Harness and multiple remote hosts into the official sidebar: remote workspaces and sessions appear as native rows, open in the official chat pane, and execute entirely on the remote host over HTTP/TLS. Remote hosts need no plugin and the UI is not iframed.
description.zh: 把本机与多台远端 DeepSeek Harness 聚合进官方侧栏：远端工作区/会话作为原生行出现、由官方中栏打开，执行始终留在远端，经 HTTP/TLS 直连。远端无需安装插件，界面不使用 iframe。

description.en: A companion plugin for dsh-pet: gives the desktop pet a persona card, Chinese reasoning lines, click reactions, and a daily diary she writes herself.
description.zh: dsh-pet 的附属插件：给桌面上的鲸鱼娘套上二次元人格，让她的思考过程说中文、被点会回话，还会每天自己写一篇日记。

description.en: A small bead-art game in the DSH Web right sidebar for the wait while the model replies: 12 built-in templates with guide beads, free drawing in 16 colors on 12/16/24 boards, a pattern drawn by the model from one sentence, on-device picture-to-pattern conversion (pictures are never uploaded), ironing finished pieces onto a wall of up to 60 works, and PNG export.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧边栏拼小拼豆的轻量小游戏，等模型回复的空档拼一张：12 个带引导豆的内置图案、16 色在 12/16/24 格板上自由拼、一句话让模型生成图纸、照片在本机转成图纸（不上传）、拼完熨烫存入最多 60 件的作品墙，并可导出 PNG。

description.en: Twenty-one fruit themes with original palettes and pixel fruit sprites for the DeepSeek Harness web client, including a settings gallery and an in-session style switcher.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端提供 21 套水果主题（原创配色与像素水果），含设置页画廊与会话内换肤入口。

description.en: An offline novel reader: imports .txt and .epub into the right sidebar, shows the chapter being read in a resizable peek window above the composer, and resumes each book at the paragraph and in-paragraph position it was closed at.
description.zh: 离线小说阅读器：把 .txt 与 .epub 导入右侧栏，在输入框上方用一个可缩放大小的速览窗显示正在读的章节，每本书都从关闭时的段落与段内位置继续。

description.en: Bottom-right DSH-styled Windows cards for approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished runs: click to jump back to the app that started the session (DSH by default), close with the × button, or let it close when you return.
description.zh: 工具请求审批、模型提问、计划待审阅或运行结束时，在右下角弹出 DSH 风格置顶卡片；点一下切回发起该会话的应用（默认 DSH），点 × 关闭，或切回时自动关闭。

description.en: Structured math problem bank with multi-solution support, layered knowledge graph and six-dimensional difficulty for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化数学题库：多解法、分层知识图谱、六维难度与技巧驱动的变式出题。

description.en: Save reusable prompt snippets with categories and {{placeholders}}; manage them with /snippet commands (add, list, rm, optimize) and insert into the composer from a draggable dock panel, with one-click AI refinement through the default model.
description.zh: 保存带分类与 {{占位符}} 的可复用提示词片段：用 /snippet 命令（add/list/rm/optimize）管理，从输入框下方可拖拽面板一键插入草稿，并支持用默认模型一键 AI 优化。

description.en: Plays a character entrance card beside the composer when you switch model: identity name, six scored axes (intelligence, coding, speed, stability, cost, context), quota hint and a dialogue line. 23 curated cards across 15 providers; models without a curated card fall back to a data card derived from public benchmarks, or a generic card when no benchmark data exists. A web client plugin with no dependencies and no hooks.
description.zh: 切换模型时在会话输入框旁播一张角色登场卡：身份名、六轴分数（智力／编码／速度／稳定／性价比／上下文）、额度提示与台词；23 张精选卡覆盖 15 个 provider，库里没有精选卡的模型按公开基准派生数据卡；基准集里也没有分数的则回退为通用卡。web 客户端插件，无依赖、无 hooks。

description.en: Saves tokens in DeepSeek Harness sessions by reading any file by line range or symbol mention instead of whole, and by bounding oversized tool results while keeping a recovery path. Pruning happens at the source, not after content reaches the context. Measured 43.9% fewer prompt tokens in a modelled 30-step session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话节省 token：按行号或符号定位读取文件而不是整份读，并对过大的工具结果设上限且保留取回路径。修剪发生在源头，而不是内容进入上下文之后。在建模的 30 步会话上实测 prompt tokens 减少 43.9%。

description.en: Shows how many GPUs on the dsh-remote host are free in the conversation header, and per-GPU utilization, memory, temperature and the owning user in a right-sidebar panel. Adds a remote_gpu tool that returns the same snapshot.
description.zh: 在会话顶栏显示 dsh-remote 所连服务器还有几张空闲显卡，右侧边栏面板展示每张卡的利用率、显存、温度与占用用户，并提供返回同一快照的 remote_gpu 工具。

description.en: Closes right-sidebar tabs with a middle click or a left double click, reusing the built-in close button so the native rules (such as the last docked guide card being unclosable) still apply.
description.zh: 右侧栏标签页支持鼠标中键关闭与左键双击关闭，关闭动作复用原生 × 按钮，原生规则（例如唯一停靠的 guide 卡片关不掉）保持不变。

description.en: Session board orb: live thinking and tool progress per session, task duration, context usage and 12h/30d usage stats; click through to any session.
description.zh: 会话看板：悬浮球一览所有工作区会话，实时显示思考与工具进展、任务耗时、上下文用量，支持近 12h/30 天用量统计，点击直达会话。

description.en: Marks a Session as focus or parked in one click from its sidebar row, its hover card, or the conversation header, and keeps a count visible at the foot of the sidebar and next to workspace folder names when those groups are collapsed. A panel lists every marked Session alongside the states the sidebar already tracks (waiting for a reply, running, finished-unread), and the sidebar foot opens whichever one needs a reply first.
description.zh: 从会话行、悬浮卡或会话头一点即可标记「进行中／挂起」；侧边栏底部和折叠的工作区名旁始终显示还有几条。面板把标记过的会话与侧边栏本就跟踪的状态（等待回复、在跑、已完成未查看）列在一起，底部读数则直接跳到最该处理的那一条。

description.en: Searches the installed skill catalog on a trigger word, requires a use-or-skip decision for every candidate, and blocks other tools until all selected skills are loaded.
description.zh: 触发词命中后先检索本机已安装的 skill，要求对每个候选登记使用或弃用的理由，并拦住其它工具直到选定的 skill 全部加载。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SolidWorks install through an MCP server, with a read-only default mode and per-call confirmation for high-risk operations. Windows 10/11 x64 only; needs Python 3.10+ with mcp, pydantic and jsonschema (plus pywin32 and comtypes on Windows) and a local SolidWorks 2023-2026 installed and started at least once.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 服务器把 DeepSeek Harness 接入本机 SolidWorks，默认只读模式，高风险操作逐次确认。仅 Windows 10/11 x64；需 Python 3.10+ 并装好 mcp、pydantic、jsonschema（Windows 上还需 pywin32、comtypes），且本机已安装并至少启动过一次 SolidWorks 2023–2026。

description.en: Splits a long QQ reply into separate messages sent a second apart, instead of one wall of text. Works only with the QQ channel streaming output turned off (im-qqbot streaming: false); with streaming on, replies bypass this plugin.
description.zh: 把 QQ 那边整段回复按标点拆成几句，隔一两秒一条条发出，而不是一次糊一大段。仅在 QQ 频道关闭流式输出（im-qqbot 设 streaming: false）时生效；流式开着时回复不经过本插件。

description.en: A permanent status card in the top-right corner of the DSH content area: one line for where this turn's time went (model, tools, waiting), plus collapsible to-dos with a progress bar, the session goal (edit/pause/resume/clear), submitted plans that open in the preview pane, the files this session changed, and subagents with their token and duration figures; it yields space to the content as the area narrows and folds into a round button at the limit.
description.zh: 内容区右上角的常驻状态卡片：一行写清本轮时间去向（模型/工具/等你），另列可折叠的任务与进度条、会话目标（可编辑/暂停/继续/清除）、已提交计划（可点开在右栏预览）、本次变更文件，以及带 token 与耗时数字的子智能体行；内容区收窄时正文向左让位，推到极限自动收成一颗圆钮。

description.en: Opens a dedicated question chat in the right sidebar for text selected in a DSH conversation, so follow-up questions do not push the main conversation away and never appear in the session list.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中一段文字，右侧栏即开出独立的提问对话，与主对话分屏并排，追问不会顶走正在学的内容，也不会出现在左侧会话列表里。

description.en: Choose three cards from a shuffled 78-card tarot deck, reveal source-linked meanings, and refine the reading through follow-up questions.
description.zh: 从洗乱的 78 张塔罗牌中亲选三张，查看带来源链接的牌义，并通过追问细化解读。

description.en: Registers a `dispatch_task` tool that hands scoped or routine work to an isolated subagent, waits for it to finish, then checks the expected files and runs an optional verification command before returning a short report to the main conversation.
description.zh: 注册 `dispatch_task` 工具，把局部或例行任务交给隔离子 Agent 执行，等待其完成后检查预期文件并运行可选的验证命令，只向主会话返回一份简短报告。

description.en: Session-header fishbone panel for sub-agent assignments, live status, available token and duration metrics, shared task-board entries, and native child-session navigation.
description.zh: 会话标题栏鱼骨图面板，展示子代理分工、实时状态、可用的 Token 与耗时指标及共享任务，并支持跳转子会话。

description.en: A dark, glassy Scaramouche theme for DeepSeek Harness with static and video wallpapers, opening video, ambient music, particles, and a draggable dock.
description.zh: 墨黑玻璃质感的原神「散兵」主题：静态/视频壁纸、开屏视频、环境音乐、粒子与可拖动控制条。

description.en: To-do list panel for DeepSeek Harness: large task cards in collapsible sections, hour-precision due times, per-task reminder lead times, and DingTalk notifications through a group robot webhook or an enterprise-app work notice. Each task can bind to a workspace session and jump to it on click.
description.zh: DSH 待办清单面板：可折叠分组中的大卡片任务，截止时间精确到小时，可按任务设置提前提醒，并通过钉钉群机器人 Webhook 或企业应用工作通知推送；任务可绑定工作区会话，点击直达。

description.en: Per-session status chips in the GNOME top bar for DeepSeek Harness — gray for running, green for done, yellow for waiting — configurable from the sidebar, with a self-installed GNOME extension.
description.zh: 在 GNOME 顶栏显示 DSH 各会话状态色块（灰=运行中，绿=已完成未确认，黄=等待回复/审批），可在侧边栏配置，自动安装 GNOME 扩展。

description.en: Browses the awesome-claude-video-skills catalog (373 entries) inside DSH settings and installs a chosen skill into ~/.claude/skills and/or ~/.dsh/skills: it downloads the GitHub archive of that repository and copies the skill directory, and executes no code from the repository. Installs run as background jobs with live progress (bytes downloaded, files copied) and can be cancelled; skills installed by the plugin can be uninstalled, while directories without its marker are left untouched. Rows show an approximate repository size reported by GitHub. The same actions are exposed to the agent as the video_skill_search, video_skill_install and video_skill_uninstall tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里浏览 awesome-claude-video-skills 目录（373 条），把选中的技能装进 ~/.claude/skills 和/或 ~/.dsh/skills：下载该仓库的 GitHub 归档并复制技能目录，不执行仓库里的任何代码。安装以后台任务运行、显示实时进度（已下载字节与已复制文件数）并可取消；本插件装上的技能可以卸载，没有本插件标记的目录保持不动。列表显示 GitHub 报告的仓库体积近似值。同样的能力也以 video_skill_search、video_skill_install、video_skill_uninstall 三个工具暴露给智能体。

description.en: Claude-styled terminal panel for the DSH web GUI: agent shell commands run in a persistent real PTY with a genuine prompt, echo and exit codes, auto-open in the right sidebar and are scoped per conversation; optional live_terminal_* tools for reading, searching and screenshotting. Fork of Lancang-hzau/dsh-live-terminal (MIT); it shares its live_terminal_* tools and right-sidebar panel, so do not install it together with the upstream plugin in the same profile.
description.zh: DSH 网页版的 Claude 风格终端面板：agent 的 shell 命令跑在常驻真终端里（真提示符、真回显、真退出码），右侧栏自动弹出并按会话隔离；可选 live_terminal_* 工具用于读取、搜索与截屏。本项目是 Lancang-hzau/dsh-live-terminal（MIT）的衍生版，沿用同一套 live_terminal_* 工具与右侧栏面板，不能与上游插件装在同一 profile。

description.en: One install for a whale-girl boot animation, a cyber code-eye video background and a holographic dark theme. The skin and background video (CC BY-NC-SA) are downloaded from the upstream repo on first launch; the boot animation is only installed when @ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation is already present.
description.zh: 一次装好鲸鱼娘开机动画、赛博代码眼动态视频背景与全息暗色主题。皮肤与背景视频（CC BY-NC-SA）在首次启动时从上游仓库下载；开机动画仅在本机已装 @ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation 时才生效。

description.en: Adds the models available in a signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness as a model provider, with the CN and international apps as separate groups. It is a rebuilt derivative of the npm package dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9 (originally corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect); it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 中的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，国内版与国际版各自成组。它基于 npm 包 dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9（原 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect）的构建产物改出，注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

description.en: Runs the locally installed ZCode CLI as a `zcode` model route in DSH: all traffic is signed by the official binary, the plugin never sends its own request, forges client requests or sends credentials off the machine (the plan token is decrypted in memory only to hand back to the official CLI), no API key is needed, and both a paid one-shot and a free app-server channel are supported. Since v0.3.0 it ships an HTTP MCP bridge so tool calls run through the DSH approval surface. Backed by a contract document and a node --test gate.
description.zh: 把本机已安装的 ZCode CLI 接成 DSH 的 `zcode` 模型路由：流量全部由官方二进制签名，插件自身不发请求、不伪造客户端请求、不把凭据传出本机（plan token 只在内存中解密并交还官方 CLI），不需要 API Key，付费一次性与免费 app-server 两条通道并存；v0.3.0 起内建 HTTP MCP 工具桥，工具调用走 DSH 的审批面；有契约文档与 node --test 测试门禁背书。

description.en: GLM Coding Plan usage quota ring in the composer dock - 5-hour and weekly credit windows with level, auto-refresh and one-click retry. Requires a GLM Coding Plan subscription and key, plus your BigModel organization and project IDs (the team quota API returns empty without them).
description.zh: 输入框下方实时显示 GLM Coding Plan 额度环 - 5 小时与每周额度窗口、等级、自动刷新与一键重试。需 GLM Coding Plan 订阅与 key，并配置 BigModel 的 organization 与 project ID（团队额度接口缺了它们会返回空）。

description.en: Monitors IEEE Xplore journal Early Access through Crossref, has an LLM screen every new paper against your keywords, and emails a Markdown weekly digest.
description.zh: 按关键词盯 IEEE 期刊 Early Access：Crossref 抓新收录，逐篇交给大模型研判，生成 Markdown 周报并发到邮箱。

description.en: Puts a hand-written markdown memory folder in front of every session — it reads only the sections you name, never summarizes or writes on its own, and fills in any starter file the folder is missing. The writing side ships as skills: one diary entry a day, the index line, the emotion value.
description.zh: 把你亲手写的 markdown 笔记文件夹摆进每个会话——只读你点名的几段，不自动总结、不替你写，缺哪个起始文件就补哪个。写的那一半做成 skill：一天一篇日记、索引行、当前情绪值。

description.en: Plain-text memory for DSH where every event is one Markdown section with six fields, recall works by element association rather than vector search, at most two old titles surface per turn, and nothing calls a model or the network. Writing the library stays manual: you can open it, grep it, correct it and carry it to another machine.
description.zh: 纯文本记忆：一条事一节、六个字段，靠元素联想而不是向量检索，每轮最多交两条旧事；不调模型、不联网，写库留给人——库能直接打开、能 grep、能改、能整份拷走。
